title: Several roads near PICC, CCP to close ahead of 49th ASEAN Summit
text:

 Several roads near PICC, CCP to close ahead of 49th ASEAN Summit
 Partial road closures start October 24 to November 9
 Jamil Lacuna Auto News 10/23/2026, 10:19 AM Google Maps, Pasay LGU Motorists are advised to avoid parts of Macapagal Boulevard, Diokno Boulevard, Roxas Boulevard, and the World Trade Center area as road closures and ASEAN lanes are taking effect ahead of the 49th ASEAN Summit.
 Several roads around the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) and the Cultural Center of the Philippines (CCP) will be temporarily closed or subject to traffic changes ahead of the 49th ASEAN Summit, scheduled for November 16 to 18, 2026.
 According to a public advisory posted by the Pasay City Public Information Office (PIO), partial road closures will be implemented from October 24 to November 9, followed by full closures of affected roads from November 9 to 20. The measures are intended to support preparations and security arrangements for the regional gathering.
 Heavy traffic and possible travel delays are expected in these areas once the closures are in place. Road users are encouraged to plan their trips ahead of time, allow additional travel time, and take alternative routes if possible. 
 Designated bus lanes will also temporarily be converted into ASEAN lanes to prioritize official vehicles and convoys carrying summit delegates. Motorists are reminded to follow traffic instructions issued by authorized personnel throughout the implementation period.
 Employees working within affected areas may be allowed to enter or pass through restricted roads by presenting a valid company identification card, subject to applicable security protocols.
